Liɗɗi maayo Liɗɗi maayo ina njeyaa e geɗe ɓurɗe waawde huutoreede e Moritani. Ina addana leydi ndii 25% e njeeygu mum fof, ina sosa ko ina ɓura 220 000 gollordu toowndu e gollordu toowndu.

Pottital Muritani e nder fannu liɗɗi : Daande maayo Moritani e nder geec Atlantik (Zone Economique Speciale) ina yaaji ko ina tolnoo e 234 000 km2 tawi ko nokku keewɗo ngalu liɗɗi, tawi njaajeendi mum ko 39 000 km2
Mbaawka Moritani e nder sekteer liɗɗi : Ɗeeɗoo daande maayo kadi ina ceerti e woodgol nokkuuji tati desorɗe maayo : Cap Blanc, Banc d’Arguin e Parc Diawling

Baawɗe Moritani to senngo liɗɗi : mbaawka Muritani e hitaande kala ina qiimee e 1 874 633 ton, tawi heen ko ina ɓura 600 eɓɓaande, tawi heen 200 ina ɗaɓɓiree no feewi e luumooji winndereeji ɗii. Muuñal tati ɓurngal yeeyde ko sefalopodeeji, ƴiye, e liɗɗi pelagik.
Pottital Moritani e sektoraa liiɗi : Limlebbi cakkitiiɗi ɗii limtii ko famɗi fof 1 200 000 ton hitaande kala, ɗum noon ina woodi haa jooni nokku ɗo njulaagu nguu ɓeydotoo.

Yimɓe ɓee, fotde 4,65 miliyoŋ hoɗɓe e hitaande 2020, ko 49,8% rewɓe. E keewal yimɓe e nder km2 fof ko 4,3 neɗɗo, Moritani woni leydi 4ɓiri ɓurndi famɗude yimɓe e nder Afrik.
E nder yimɓe mum fotde miliyoŋaaji 4 neɗɗo, e wertallo mum ko 1 030 700 km2, keewal yimɓe leydi Moritani ina jeyaa e ɓurɗe famɗude e winndere ndee.

Jaŋde toownde leydi Moritani ina jokki e hitaande 1981. Ndee duɗal jaaɓi-haaɗtirde (Universities in Mauritania) ina rokka fannuuji keewɗi, ina heen gannde alkule e gannde aadee, sariya, e faggudu. Gaa gaa duɗal jaaɓi-haaɗtirde Nuwaaksot, Moritani ina jaɓɓoo duɗe janngirɗe goɗɗe ko wayi no duɗal wiɗto ko faati e njulaagu e njulaagu, nokku jaŋde lislaam, e nokku janngirde gollotooɓe njuɓɓudi laamu, tawi fof ina tawee e laamorgo leydi ndii, hono Nuwaaksot.

Doggol Jaaɓi-haaɗtirde Moritani
Moritani ko leydi tawaandi e hirnaange Afrik jogiindi duɗe jaaɓi-haaɗtirde seeɗa baɗɗe jaŋde toownde e fannuuji keewɗi. Ko ɗoo doggol yoga e duɗe jaaɓi-haaɗtirde ɓurɗe maantinde e Moritani :

Duɗal jaaɓi-haaɗtirde Nuwaaksot : Ko ngal duɗal jaaɓi-haaɗtirde ɓurngal mawnude e ɓooyde e nder leydi Moritani, sosaangal e hitaande 1981. Ngol woni ko e laamorgo leydi Nuwaaksot, ngol ina rokka jaŋde leslesre e jaŋde leslesre e fannuuji ko wayi no gannde neɗɗankaagal, gannde renndo, gannde tago, e karallaagal.

Duɗal Polytechnique Toowngal (ESP) to Nouakchott ko duɗal ganndal, sosaangal e hitaande 1657, ngal ministeer ndeenka ngenndi e ministeer kalfinaaɗo ganndal toowngal e wiɗto ganndal1 2011.Duɗal ngal ina yaakorii sosde formation d’ingéniers, recrutés ko adii jooni e nder kawgel naatgol sarɗiiji ngam heɓde Bac, tawa kadi ko e ballal biisuuji naatgol parallèles wonande duɗe jaaɓi haaɗtirde.

Duɗal jaaɓi-haaɗtirde ganndal, karallaagal e safaara leydi Moritani : Ko ngal duɗal jaaɓi-haaɗtirde laamu tawaangal e wuro Nouakchott sosaande e hitaande 2001. Ko ngal ganndal e karallaagal, ngal rokka jaŋde leslesre e jaŋde leslesre e fannuuji ko wayi no ganndal ordinateer, ganndal innde, hiisa, e fisik.

Duɗal ngenndiwal njuɓɓudi : Ko ngal duɗal laamu tawaangal e nder wuro Nouakchott ngal sosaa ko e hitaande 1982. Ko ngal teskinngal e njuɓɓudi laamu, ngal rokkata kadi porogaraamuuji jaŋde leslesre e jaŋde leslesre e fannuuji ko wayi no njuɓɓudi laamu, kaalis laamu, e jokkondiral hakkunde leyɗeele.

Duɗal ngenndiwal gannde e karallaagal : Ko ngal duɗal laamu tawaangal e wuro Nouakchott sosaangal e hitaande 1999. Ko ngal fannu ganndal e karallaagal, ngal rokka kadi porogaraamuuji jaŋde leslesre e jaŋde leslesre e fannuuji ko wayi no ndema, semmbe, e gannde weeyo.

Ɗeeɗoo ko yeruuji seeɗa e duɗe jaaɓi-haaɗtirde e koleeji gonɗi e Moritani. Kala e ɗeen duɗe ina jogii doole mum e fannuuji mum, ko ɗum waɗi ina moƴƴi wiɗteede e ƴeewteede no moƴƴi so en ƴeewii fartaŋŋeeji jaŋde toownde e nder leydi Moritani.

Jaɓɓungal e gollorɗe Moritani ina ceerti e jillondiral geɗe aadaaji e geɗe jamaanu. E nder laddeeji, yah-ngartaa e daabaaji pack ko wayi no gelooɗi, e pucci ina heddii e nafoore. Kono tan, yah-ngartaa laabi ina ɓeydoo heewde ngam jokkondirde gure e diiwanuuji. Leydi ndii ina jogii caɗeele teeŋtuɗe e mahngo laabi sabu mbayliigu nguu, e ilam ɗam, e kaaƴe ɓutte. Ɗee caɗeele fof e wayde noon, won laabi teeŋtuɗi ina ngolloo hitaande kala, ko wayi no laawol mawngol jokkondirngol Rosso e Tindouf, Alseri, rewrude e Nuwaas, Akjoujt, Atar, Fdérik, e Bîr Mogreïn. Ko ina tolnoo e tataɓal laabi Moritani ko pawaaɗi.

Yaakaare Moritani , timminaande e hitaande 1982, ina jokkondiri e Nuwaksot e bannge hirnaange leydi ndii rewrude e Kaédi, Kiffa, ʿAyoun el-ʿAtrous, e Néma. Yanti heen, laawol mawngol hakkunde worgo-fuɗnaange jokkondirngol e Nuwaasoot e Nuwaadhibou timminaama e hitaande 2004. Moritani ina jogii kadi laawol laana njoorndi jokkondirngol e nokkuuji njulaagu Zouérate, Guelb El Rheïn, e Mhaoudat e porto to Nuwaadhibou, hay so tawii noon laawol laana njoorndi ina famɗi.

Laanaaji diwooje hakkunde leyɗeele ina tawee e Nuwaaksot, Aeroport hakkunde leyɗeele Nuwaaksot–Oumtounsy ko laamorgo diwooje hakkunde leyɗeele gollortoongo Nuwaksot, laamorgo leydi Moritani. O woni ko 25 kiloomeeteer to fuɗnaange wuro ngoo. Aeroport oo udditaa ko e lewru suwee 2016 ngam lomtaade Aeroport hakkunde leyɗeele Nouakchott.

Daartol leydi Moritani gila nde heɓi jeytaare mum e hitaande 1960, ko mbayliigaaji politik e mbayliigaaji ardorde. Leydi ndi heɓi jeytaare mum e les njiimaandi hooreejo leydi ndii hono Moktar Uld Daddah, ardinooɗo haa kuudetaa konu e hitaande 1978. Ardiiɓe caggal ɗuum ko Mustafaa Uld Salek, Mohamed Mahmuud Uld Louly, e Mohamed Khouna Uld Haidalla, gooto e maɓɓe fof ina joginoo caɗeele jowitiiɗe e deeƴre nder leydi e diiwaan.

E hitaande 1984, Maaouya Ould Sid'Ahmed Taya heɓti laamu e kuudetaa, o huutorii politik aarabeeɓe e peewnugol faggudu haa o woppitaa e hitaande 2005. Leydi ndii yiyti ndeen dumunna juutɗo e peewnugol demokaraasi e gardagol Ely Ould Mohamed Vall, caggal ɗuum kuudetaa mo Azmed brought Mo80. Aziz ardiima haa e hitaande 2019 nde Mohamed Ould Cheikh Ghazouani toɗɗaa, ko ɗum woni ko adii fof ko dogde laamu e dow jam e nder daartol Moritani.

Daartol ardorde leydi Moritani ina maantiniri limlebbi keewɗi e mbayliigaaji politik gila nde heɓi jeytaare mum e juuɗe Farayse e hitaande 1960.

Moktar Ould Daddah
Duuɓi: 1961-1978
Baɗte : Hooreejo leydi Moritani jeytaare gadano, hono Ould Daddah, waɗii nafoore mawnde e renndinde leƴƴi ceertuɗi leydi ndii e les njiimaandi laamu doolnuɗo. O sosi laamu lannda gooto ngam tabitinde ngootaagu ngenndi, o woppitaa e kuudetaa konu e hitaande 1978 sabu makko weltaade e politik makko, haa teeŋti noon e ko fayti e Saharaa worgo.
Ardiiɓe konu e kuudetaaji
Mustafaa Uld Salek : Ardiima kuudetaa liɓnooɗo Uld Daddaa e hitaande 1978. Laamu makko juutaani, sibu o woppi laamu e hitaande 1979.
Mohamed Mahmuud Uld Louly : Lomtiima Uld Salek, siifondiri nanondiral e Fedde Polisario, ɗum ɓeydi bonde jokkondiral hakkunde makko e Maruk.
Mohamed Khouna Uld Haidalla : Toppitii laamu e hitaande 1980, lomtii ɗum ko Maaouya Uld Sid’Ahmed Taya e hitaande 1984.
Maaouya Ould sid'ahmed taaya
Duuɓi : 1984-2005
Doosɗe : Huuɓtidini politikaaji aarabeeɓe e peewnugol faggudu, e sosde njuɓɓudi lanndaaji keewɗi. Laamu makko joofi ko e kuudetaa e hitaande 2005.
Ely Ould Mohamed Vall
Duuɓi : 2005-2007
Darnde : Ardii kuudetaa 2005 e fuɗɗoraade peeje demokaraasi, haa arti noon e waylude doosɗe leydi ngam ustude manndaa hooreejo leydi.
Siidi uld cheikh abdallahi
Duuɓi : 2007-2008
Nafoore : Hooreejo leydi gadano cuɓaaɗo e demokaraasi, ittuɗo e kuudetaa konu e hitaande 2008 sabu jiiɓru politik.
Mohamed Uld Abdel Aziz
Duuɓi: 2009-2019
Jaɓɓungal : Addi deeƴre e ɓeydagol faggudu kono jokkondiri e ñiŋooje sabu politikaaji cemmbinɗi. O ɗaɓɓaani manndaa tataɓo, o jaɓi Mohamed Uld Ghazouani.
Mohamed uld cheikh gazouani
Hooreejo leydi hannde oo : Gila 2019
Kewu teeŋtuɗo : Fiilngo makko ko ngol woni go’o ko Moritani ina heɓa laamu e nder demokaraasi.

Turismo e nder leydi Moritani ina jogii mbaawkaaji keewɗi sabu ngalu leydi ndi e nder tagoodi e pinal. Ko ɓuri teeŋtude e nokkuuji ɗii ko nokkuuji taariindi Banc d’Arguin e gure tariya Tichit, Chinguetti, Ouadâne, e Oualâta, ɗeeɗoo geɗe fof ko nokkuuji ndonaandi winndereeji UNESCO. Ɗeeɗoo nokkuuje ina teeŋtina tariya Moritani keewngol e ekosistemaaji mum ceertuɗi, ina ndokka njilluuji yiɗɓe pinal e tago geɗe keewɗe.

E cakkital kitaale 1990, laamu Muritani fuɗɗii waɗtude hakkille mum e ƴellitde fannu turism ngam feewnude faggudu. Feere duuɓi 10 hollitaama e hitaande 2002 ngam ɓeydaade ɓamtude turism. Kono tan, gollordu nduu ina wondi e caɗeele sabu kulhuli kisal caggal nde njilluuji mbaɗi e turism, ɗum noon ina metti no feewi golle turism. Ngonka kaa fuɗɗii moƴƴude ko caggal hitaande 2017 nde ministeer Farayse caggal leydi ustii jeertinaango mum e yah-ngartaa leydi ndii, ɗum addani njilluuji turism ɓeydaade seeɗa seeɗa.

Ɗee caɗeele fof e wayde noon, fannu turism Moritani ina jokki e ƴellitaade, ina huutoroo geɗe mum keertiiɗe e ndonu pinal mum. Laamu nguu ina heddii e daranaade ƴellitde faggudu nduu, tawa ina anndi mbaawkaaji mum ngam wallitde keewal faggudu e ɓeydagol.

nganndumi ko fatti moritani :  Moritani leydi tawaandi e daande maayo Atlantik Afrik, ko ndi jokkorgal geɗe leydi e pinal hakkunde diiwaan Magrib worgo Afrik e nokku ɓurɗo hirnaange Afrik worgo Saharaa. Ko nokku gonɗo hakkunde yimɓe aarabeeɓe-amazigh en (berbeer en) e Afrik worgo e leƴƴi Afrik fuɗnaange Tropic Cancer, anndiraaɗo Sudaan. Ko ɓuri heewde e leydi Moritani ina jeyaa e jeereende Saharaa, e nder tariya, feccere mawnde e yimɓe mum ko hoɗɓe e nokkuuji ɗii, haa yooro e kitaale 1970 yani e diiwaan hee.

Leydi ndii ina heewi ngalu keewngu, ina heen kadi keɓe mawɗe, ko wayi no njamndi mboɗeeri, njamndi mboɗeeri, e jippunde, ɗe kuutortee ko no feewi, kam e won e geɗe petroŋ. Moritani ko leydi Farayse e nder feccere adannde e teeminannde 20siire, heɓi jeytaare mum ñalnde 28 noowammbar 1960. Lislaam ko diine laawɗuɗo, kono doosgal leydi ina ɗaɓɓi ndimaagu ɓernde e ndimaagu diine. Ko Arab woni ɗemngal laawɗungal, Fula, Soninke, e Wolof nganndaa ko ɗemɗe ngenndiije. Laamorgo leydi ndii, hono Nouakchott, woni ko e bannge worgo-fuɗnaange leydi ndii.
Moritani ina hollita sosiyeteeji keewɗi e nder fannuuji keewɗi, ina jeyaa heen njulaagu e karallaagal.

doggol sosiyeteeji mawɗi e nder leydi Moritani e nder fannuuji ceertuɗi:

Miniraagal:
Sosiyetee ngenndiijo njulaagu e njulaagu (SNIM) : Sosiyetee mawɗo njulaagu njamndi golloowo e diiwaan Zouérate.

BP : Ardii eɓɓaande LNG Ahmeyim (GTA) mawnde.

Teknik ko sosiyeteeji teknoloji to nuwasoot :

Moritani : ko kañum woni gollorgal ɓurngal mawnude e telefoŋaaji e nder leydi Moritani.

nokkuuji ɓurɗi welde e moritani Ina jeyaa e nokkuuji ɓurɗi teskinde ɗii, Chinguetti, wuro ɓooyngo ngo meeɗiino wonde nokku mawɗo jaŋde e njulaagu lislaam.

Juulirde Chinguetti, anndiraande kadi juulirde mawnde Chinguetti, ko juulirde lislaam sunnit en to Chinguetti, diiwaan Adrar, leydi Moritani. Ko nokku dewal ɓooyɗo mo sosnooɓe wuro oasis Chinguetti e nder diiwaan Adrar to leydi Moritani sosi e teeminannde sappo e tatiire walla sappo e nayaɓere.
nokkuuji ɓurɗi teskinde ɗii, Chinguetti Ko ɗoon woni galle mahdiiji jamaanu hakkundeejo, Juulirde mawnde Chinguetti, e defte ɓooyɗe teemedde duuɓi, ina ndesnda binndanɗe juɓɓuɗe.

Nuwaasoot (Nouakchott) woni laamorgo leydi Moritani, Tawi ko bannge worgo-fuɗnaange leydi ndi, ngo jeyaa ko e gure ɓurɗe mawnude e nder leydi ndi. Wuro ngo kadi ko nokku njuɓɓudi e faggudu leydi Moritani.
Nuwaasoot (Nouakchott) ina waɗi Nuwaasoot Fuɗnaange, Nuwaasoot hirnaange, e Nuwaasoot worgo.

Nuwaasoot Nouakchott ko laamorgo e wuro ɓurngo mawnude e leydi Moritani , leydi ndi woni e Fuɗnaange-rewo Afrik. Ko ɗeeɗoo geɗe teeŋtuɗe jowitiiɗe e Nouakchott :

1. **Nokku** : Ko e daande maayo Atlantik e nder jeereende Saharaa.

2. **Yimɓe** : E limtooji cakkitiiɗi ɗii, wuro ngoo ina waɗi ko ina tolnoo e miliyoŋaaji 1 neɗɗo, ɗum noon ko wuro ɓurngo heewde yimɓe e nder leydi Moritani.

3. **Daartol** : Nouakchott ko wuro tokooso haa e hitaande 1958 nde suɓaa wonde laamorgo leydi Moritani, ndi wonnoo e oon sahaa njiimaandi Farayse. Nde warti laamorgo ɓaawo jeytaare lesdi man nder hitaande 1960.

4. **Faggudu**: Wuro ngo woni huɓeere faggudu e njuɓɓudi leydi Moritani. Industiriiji mawɗi ina mbaɗi liɗɗi, nde tawnoo wuro ngoo ina ɓadii nokkuuji liɗɗi alɗuɗi, e njulaagu. Port Nouakchott ko nokku keewɗo faayiida wonande naatgol e yaltugol.

5. **Pine**: Nouakchott ko nokku ɓuuɓɗo leƴƴi ceertuɗi, ina jeyaa heen Moor en, Wolof en, Soninke en, e woɗɓe. Ngalɗoo keewal ina feeñi e pinal wuro ngoo, ɗemɗe mum, e ñaamdu mum.

6. **Maandeeji** : Maandeeji teeŋtuɗi ina njeyaa heen juulirde Nuwaasoot, suudu defte ngenndiiru Moritani, e luumo kaalis Nuwaasoot. Wuro ngoo ina waɗi kadi beeli keewɗi, ko wayi no Plage de Nouakchott.

7. **Kliima**: Wuro ngo ina jogii weeyo jeereende ngulngo, nguleeki mum ina toowi no feewi e nder ñalawma, jammaaji ina cooynii. Toɓo ina famɗi.

8. **Nguurndam** : Nouakchott yiytii ƴellitaare mawnde gila nde wonti laamorgo, kono haa jooni ina jokki e caɗeele ko wayi no ŋakkeende gollorɗe e sarwisaaji. Wuro ngo ina waɗi mahdiiji jamaanu e koɗkiiji ɗi ngonaa laamuyankooji.

9. **Njaajeendi** : Wuro ngoo ina huutoree e Aeroport hakkunde leyɗeele Nouakchott–Oumtounsy, jokkondirɗo e gure mawɗe goɗɗe e nder Afrik e caggal mum. Jaɓɓungal yimɓe nder wuro ngo ina waɗi otooji e taksiiji.

10. **Caɗeele** : Hono no gure keewɗe mawnuɗe e nder leyɗeele ƴellitiiɗe ɗee nii, Nouakchott ina jogii caɗeele ko wayi no : ŋakkeende gure, baasal, e caɗeele weeyo, haa arti noon e ŋakkeende jeereende e ŋakkeende ndiyam.

Nouakchott ko wuro ceertungo, ɗo pinal Saharaa hawri e ƴellitaare wuro hannde.

Nouadhibou (Nuwadhibu) ko wuro tawaango to worgo-fuɗnaange leydi Moritani e nder duunde Kap Nuwadhibu, ina fadi haa bannge maayo Atlantik. Wuro mawngo e nokku faggudu, ganndiraaɗo liɗɗi, njulaagu njamndi, e nokku mum njulaagu.

Nouadhibou (Nuwadhibu) ƴellitiima no feewi e nokku liɗɗi, kono nafoore mum faggudu ɓurnde mawnude ummorii ko e njeeygu njamndi toowndi. Ɗumɗoo ina weeɓi e laawol laana njoorndi 419 kiloomeeteer jokkondirngol Nouadhibou e koɗli njamndi saraaji Zouérat e Fdérik.
ko fayti e leydi moritani (moritani) : Moritani ko leydi tawaandi e daande maayo Atlantik Afrik, ko ndi jokkorgal geɗe leydi e pinal hakkunde Magreb Afrik worgo e Afrik worgo Saharaa.

ko fayti e leydi moritani Nde anndiraa ko ndonu pinal ceertuɗo, tawi ina waɗi batte aarabeeɓe (berber) e Afrik. Ko ɓuri heewde e leydi ndii ina jeyaa e jeereende Saharaa, e nder tariya, feccere mawnde e yimɓe leydi ndii ko hoɗɓe e leydi ndii haa yooro e kitaale 1970.

ko fayti e leydi moritani Moritani heɓnoo jeytaare mum e juuɗe leydi Farayse ñalnde 28 noowammbar 1960. Ko ndenndaandi Islaamiyankoori ndi Arab woni ɗemngal laawɗungal, Fula, Soninke, e Wolof woni ɗemɗe ngenndiije. Laamorgo mayri ko Nouakchott , woni ko bannge funnaange-rewo leydi ndi.

ko fayti e leydi moritani To bannge faggudu, Moritani ina jogii ngalu keewngu, ina jeyaa heen njamndi mboɗeeri, copper, and gypsum, ina jogii kadi ngalu petroŋ. Faggudu nduu ina feccii hakkunde golle nguura gaadanteeje ko wayi no ndema, e faggudu njulaagu jamaanu, jowitiindu e njulaagu e liɗɗi.

Moritani woni ko e Afrik hirnaange. leyɗele keedɗe mum ko Saharaa hirnaange to fuɗnaange-rewo, Alseri to fuɗnaange-rewo, Mali to fuɗnaange e fuɗnaange-rewo, e Senegaal to fuɗnaange-rewo. Leydi ndii ina jogii kadi daande maayo Atlantik to bannge worgo.
Arab woni ɗemngal (language) laawɗungal leydi Moritani, kono Farayse ina heewi haaleede. Pulaar e soninke e wolof woni ɗemɗe ngenndiije.
Lislaam ko diine dowla (state) leydi Moritani. Yimɓe ɓee ina kuutoroo Lislaam sunniyanke mo njuɓɓudi duɗal Maliki, ko lislaam muñɗo no feewi. Ina woodi kadi banndiraaɓe diine ɗooftaare suufiyankoore.
Moritani ko leydi gonndi e Afrik. Moritani ina waɗi ponto geɗe leydi e pinal hakkunde Magreb Afrik worgo e feccere ɓurnde hirnaange Afrik worgo Saharaa.
To bannge pinal leydi Moritani, ina waɗi nokku gonɗo hakkunde yimɓe aarabeeɓe en (berber en) e Afrik worgo e leƴƴi Afrik wonɓe e diiwaan hee to bannge worgo Tropic Cancer
Leydi Moritani njuɓɓinaama no koloni Farayse e nder feccere adannde e teeminannde 20ɓiire, heɓi jeytaare mum ñalnde 28 noowammbar 1960.
E nder sarɗiiji doosɗe leydi Moritani, Lislaam ko diine laawɗuɗo, kono republique ina ɗaɓɓi ndimaagu ɓernde e ndimaagu diine wonande yimɓe fof.
Laamorgo leydi moritani ndii wiyetee ko Nouakchott woni ko bannge funnaange-rewo leydi ndii
ko faati e weeyo leydi moritani, Kiliima Moritani e nder Nokkuuji daande maayo, ko wayi no Nuwaaksot e Nuwaadhibou, ina njogii kiliimaaji belɗi sabu geeƴ Atlantik.

ko fayti e weeyo moritani Weeyo Moritani ɓuri heewde ko yooro, ina jogii batte e henndu njulaagu fuɗnaange-rewo e harmattan, henndu ngulndu, yoorndu ummortoondu fuɗnaange-rewo walla fuɗnaange. Ɗum ina addana weeyo ngo heewi wonde ko yoorngo, toɓooli ina pamɗi. Toɓo ina waɗa e bannge worgo leydi ndii, toɓooli ina ustoo seeɗa seeɗa gila fuɗnaange haa worgo. Yeru, Sélibabi to fuɗnaange toowɗo ina heɓa fotde 25 inch (635 mm) toɓo hakkunde lewru suwee e oktoobar, Nouâdhibou to bannge worgo ina heɓa tan ko 1 haa 2 inch (25 haa 50 mm) ko ɓuri heewde ko hakkunde lewru settaambar e noowammbar.

ko faati e weeyo leydi moritani, Moritani ina jogii weeyo ngulngo, njoorngo, ko ɓuri heewde e leydi mum ko jeereende Saharaa. Temperaaji ina keewi e nder hitaande ndee kala, haa teeŋti noon e nder weeyo, ɗo ɗi mbaawi ɓurde 45°C (113°F) e ceɗou.

ko faati e pinal moritani Ko ina wona tataɓal yimɓe moritani ɓuri heewde ko leƴƴi nay goɗɗi : Tukulor, hoɗɓe e falnde maayo Senegaal ; Fulɓe, sankitiiɓe e nder fuɗnaange fof ; Soninke, hoɗɓe e fuɗnaange toowɗo ; e Wolof en, hoɗɓe e saraaji Rosso to bannge worgo-fuɗnaange Moritani.
ko faati e pinal moritani, Gooto e leƴƴi(ethnic) moritani ina haala ɗemngal aarabeeɓe Hasniyyah, ɗemngal ngal ɗemɗe mum ɓuri heewde ummoraade e aarabeeɓe e huutoraade kelme aarabeeɓe.
ko faati e pinal moritani Ina jeyaa e leƴƴi(ethnic) moritani, Tukulor en e Fulɓe wonɓe eɓe kaala Fulfulde (Fulfulde, Pulaar), ɗemngal caltal Atlantik Afrik.
ko faati e pinal moritani Leƴƴi keddiiɗi ɗii ko soninke en e wolof en.
Arab woni ɗemngal lawwaangal e Moritani; Fula, Soninke, e Wolof ina njaɓaa wonde ɗemɗe ngenndiije, Arab e Farayse ngonni ko ɗemɗe janngirɗe e nder duɗe leydi Moritani.
E nder diiwaan Sahel to leydi Moritani, faggudu nguura aadaaji, ko wayi no ndema, karallaagal, e njulaagu tokoosi ina wallita ko ɓuri heewde e yimɓe leydi ndii.
Kono e nder diiwaan Saharaa to leydi Moritani, faggudu njulaagu kesiri ina ƴellitoo, tuugiindi e huutoraade ngalu njamndi e copper mboɗeeri e ndiyam liɗɗi keewɗi e nder geeƴ.
Faggudu leydi Moritani ina heɓa ballal kapitaal e karallaagal kesal ummoraade e caggal leydi.

ko faati e faggudu leydi moritani Ko ɓuri tataɓal (3/4) yimɓe leydi Moritani ina mbaɗa golle gaadanteeje, tawi heen jawdi ɓuri heen teeŋtude. To bannge limoore, ko be’i e baali ɓuri teeŋtude e jawdi, rewi heen ko na’i e gelooɗi. Na’i ɓuri heewde ko e diiwaan fuɗnaange, tawi noon be’i e baali ina ceerti haa to bannge worgo haa e keerol Sahara. Gelooɗi ɓuri waawde rewde ko to bannge worgo e hakkundeere, haa teeŋti noon e diiwaan Adrar.

Mawnugol faggudu leydi Moritani ina leeltini e kitaale 1980 caggal nde yahrude yeeso no feewi e kitaale 1960 e 1970. Gila yooro mawngo e fuɗɗoode kitaale 1970, leydi ndii ina fawii e nguura nguura ngam ñamminde yimɓe mum.

ko faati e faggudu leydi moritani, E fuɗɗoode kitaale 1980 peewnugol njamndi mboɗeeri ustii sabu ustaare cogguuli luumooji winndere ; liɗɗi ngonti ko ɓuri heewde e dañal kaalis caggal leydi, ko noon kadi woniri ko ɓuri heewde e kitaale 1990. E nder cakkital kitaale 1990 laamu nguu fuɗɗii hollude darnde mum e ƴellitde faggudu leydi ndii ngam ɓeydude keewal faggudu Moritani
ko faati e faggudu leydi moritani, Ngalu leydi Moritani ina waɗi geɗe keewɗe, ko wayi no njamndi mboɗeeri, copper, e gypsum, tawi ko ɗiin fof ina kuutoree hannde, kam e won e geɗe petroŋ.
ko faati e faggudu leydi moritani, Moritani ina jeyaa e leyɗe ɓurɗe alɗude e coñce liɗɗi e winndere ndee : liɗɗi geeƴ ina njeyaa e geɗe ɓurɗe waawde huutoreede e nder Moritani.

ko faati e faggudu leydi moritani, Huutoraade njamndi yuɓɓinaama, fuɗɗii ko e hitaande 1963 e fedde wiyeteende Société Anonyme des Mines de Fer de moritanie (MIFERMA), tawi heen 56% e kaalis oo ko pelle Farayse, heddii ko nafooje Angalteer, Almaañ hirnaange, e Itaali e laamu Moritani. Sosiyetee oo waɗtaa ngenndiijo e hitaande 1974, o innitiraa Sosiyetee ngenndiijo njulaagu e miniraagal (SNIM).
ko faati e faggudu leydi moritani, Pewnugol ngol ɓuri teeŋtude ko e gollorɗe njulaagu e liɗɗi, ko wonaa ɗuum ina famɗi. Ina heen gollorɗe tokoose peewnirteeɗe nguura e mahngo
Banke mawɗo Moritani sosaa ko e hitaande 1973, yaltinnde kaalis ngenndi ouguiya.
Kaalis leydi Moritani wiyetee ko Ouguiya Moritani (MRU).

Parc National Banc d’Arguin ko nokku reenaaɗo, nokku taariindi winndere, gooto e nokkuuji ɓurɗi alɗude e liɗɗi e winndere ndee. Ko ɗoon kadi woni galle ko ina ɓura miliyoŋaaji ɗiɗi colli dillooji, ko ɗoon kadi ƴiye geeƴ e ƴiye monk.

Yimɓe Moritani ina njeyaa e ɓurɓe famɗude e winndere nde, ko ina ɓura 60% e nder 4,5 miliyoŋ hoɗɓe e leydi ndii ina njogii duuɓi 25. Yanti heen, to bannge etno-pinal, Moritani ina alɗi e keewal pinal leƴƴi mum ceertuɗi, denndinɗi diine mum en, Islaam, kono gooto fof ina jogii sifaa mum tiiɗɗo, aadaaji mum e aadaaji mum asliiji. Ko zuum heewi wi’eede wonde Moritani ina hollira jeese Afrik fof e nder leydi ngootiri. Yimɓe ɓee ko Moor en, Aarabeeɓe-Berber en, Peul en ina gasa tawa ummoriiɓe Ejipt, Soninkes en, ummoriiɓe e fedde mawnde Mandingo nde sosi laamlaamuuji keewɗi, nde doolni semmbe mum haa yettii Saharaa, e Wolof en, hoɗɓe ummoriiɓe Tekrour ɓooyɗo, ngal pinal mum en ina woodi e nder waalo les maayo Senegaal fof

Fulbe en, anndiraaɓe kadi Fulɓe, ko leñol maantinngol e nder leydi Moritani, anndaangol e aadaaji mum en e nguurndam mum en durooɓe. Ɓe ngoni ko e diiwaan Fulɓe ɓurɗo mawnude, saraaji Afrik hirnaange. To bannge tariya, Fulɓe ina njogii semmbe e nder diiwaan hee, haa teeŋti noon e naatgol mum en e jihaadiiji keewɗi e sosde laamuuji juulɓe e nder Sudaan hirnaange e nder teeminannde 17ɓiire e 18ɓiire.

E Moritani, Fulbe ina njeyaa e leƴƴi ceertuɗi, ballitooji mbaydi pinal e renndo leydi ndii. Laamu Moritani golliima ngam renndinde ɗeen pelle ceertuɗe, tawi ina jeyaa heen Fulɓe, e nder pinal ngenndiwal renndinde, ɓurngal heewde tuugnaade e Lislaam. Fulɓe Moritani hono no nokkuuji goɗɗi ɗii nii, ɓeydii jooɗaade e nder renndooji duumiiɗi hay so tawii won heen ina njokki e jogaade aadaaji mum en durngol.

Fulbe nder Moritani ɗon nder limngal leƴƴi ɓurduɗi yaajugo, hawtaade e Maor’en, Berber’en, e woɓɓe feere, kamɓe fuu ɓe ɗon mari Islaama bana semmbe diina kawtal. Ndee diine renndinde wallitii ngam ustude ceergal leƴƴi e ƴellitde jikkuuji ngenndiiji e nder leydi Moritani.
Leñol Fulbe, anndiraangol kadi Fulɓe, ɓuri haalde ko ɗemngal Fula, ngal wiyetee kadi ko Fulfulde, Pular, walla Peul. Ene haalee no feewi e nder Afrik hirnaange, haa arti noon e Moritani.

Soninke en ko leñol e nder leydi Moritani, ko ɓuri heewde e mum en ko hoɗɓe e nokkuuji ɓurɗi toowde e fuɗnaange leydi ndii. Ɓe njeyaa ko e leƴƴi Mande ɓurɗi yaajde ɗii, eɓe kaala ɗemngal Mande, ngal woni calɗi e nder galle ɗemɗe Niiseer-Konngo.  Soninke en ina nganndiraa sosde laamu Ganaa ɓooyngu, nguu laamu mawngu e nder Afrik hirnaange haa nde ustii e teeminannde 10ɓiire sabu njiimaandi juulɓe.

E nder leydi Moritani, soninke ina jeyaa e leƴƴi keewɗi, e saraaji Maori en, Tukulor en, Fulɓe, e Wolof en. Soninkooɓe, hono leƴƴi keddiiɗi ɗii e nder Moritani ɗii, ina njogii golle ɗemngal mum en e pinal mum en.

Leñol Wolof e nder leydi Moritani ɓuri hoɗde ko e saraaji Rosso to bannge worgo-fuɗnaange leydi ndii. Wolof ina kaala zemngal Wolof jeyaangal e caltal Atlantik e nder galle ɗemɗe Niiseer-Konngo, ngal anndaa no ɗemngal ngenndiwal e nder leydi Moritani.
Wolof ina jogii ngalu pinal keewngu, ina jokkondiri  e Laamaandi Wolof, ndi wonnoo dowla cemmbinɗo e nder ko woni hannde nder leydi Senegaal e nder teeminannde 14ɓiire haa 16ɓiire.

ko faati (fayti) e diiwanuuji e gure moritani : Moritani ina feccii e diiwanuuji keewɗi, heen diiwanuuji fof ina jogii sifaaji mum keertiiɗi e gure mum teeŋtuɗe : Diiwaan Adrar : gure teeŋtuɗe ina njeyaa heen Atar e Chinguetti, inna andira ko ɗe nafoore tariya e defte ɓooyɗe.

ko faati (fayti) e diiwanuuji e gure moritani:   Diiwaan Tagant : Ina jeyaa heen wuro Tidjikdja, nokku njulaagu taariindi goɗɗo. Hodh Ech Chargui e Hodh El Gharbi : Ɗee diiwanuuji ina njeyaa e nokkuuji ɓurɗi mawnude e Hodh, ganndiraaɗo ndema jawdi. Diiwaan Trarza : Ina woni to bannge worgo-fuɗnaange, ina jeyaa heen laamorgo leydi ndii, hono Nouakchott, ko kañum woni cakaare ɓurnde mawnude e nder wuro, kadi ko kañum woni nokku politik e faggudu leydi ndii. },

ko faati (fayti) e diiwanuuji e gure moritani :   Nouadhibou : Ko e nder diiwaan Dakhlet Nouadhibou, ko wuro laamorgo mawngo, ko nokku njulaagu liɗɗi e njulaagu njamndi. Diiwaan Tiris Zemmour : Ina anndaa e golle mum njulaagu, haa teeŋti noon e wuro Zouérat, ngo woni nokku njulaagu njamndi. Diiwanuuji Brakna, Gorgol, e Guidimaka : Ɗee diiwanuuji ina tawee e maayo Senegaal, ina mbaɗi gure bayɗe no Kaédi, Bogué, e Sélibabi, ko ɓuri teeŋtude e ndema e njulaagu.

ko fayti e gure leydi moritania eden jiogui 13 diiwan inna waddi :  Nouakchott, Dakhlet Nouadhibou – Nouadhibou, Trarza – Rosso, Brakna – Aleg, Gorgol – Kaédi, Guidimaka – Sélibaby, Assaba – Kiffa, Hodh El Gharbi – Aïoun el Atrouss, Hodh Ech Chargui – Néma, Tagant – Tidjikja, Tiris Zemmour – Zouerate, Inchiri – Akjoujt.

ko fayti e e gure moritani : Leydi Moritani feccii ko e 13 diiwaan (wilaya), heen diiwan fof ina jogii wuro mum mawngo : Nouakchott woni laamorgo mum. nokku faggudu leydi ndii ; Daklet Nuwaadibu, tawi Nuwaadibu ko porto mawɗo e nokku faggudu ; Trarza, e Rosso, wuro keeriingo e njulaagu mawngo; Brakna, wondude e Aleg, nokku ndema ; Gorgol, wondude e Kaédi, wuro mawngo e maayo; Guidimaka, wondude e Sélibaby, ganndiraaɗo ngaynaaka e njulaagu; Assaba, wondude e Kiffa, nokku njulaagu diiwaan oo ; Hodh El Garbi, e Aïoun El Atrouss, wuro mawngo jolngo ; Hodh Ech Chargui, wonndude e Néma, nokku njuɓɓudi laamu teeŋtuɗo; Tagant, wondude e Tidjikja, ganndiraaɗo oasiiji mum e tariya mum; Adrar, wondude e Atar, nokku njillu e pinal; Tiris Zemmour, wondude e Zouerate, wuro mawngo njulaagu; e Inchiri, wondude e Akjoujt, ganndiraaɗo gaññeeje njamndi e kaŋŋe.
